name: Kawabe (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Kawabe town emblem in white: an outlined oval loop enclosing a stylised character of diagonal strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Kawabe, a town in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Kawabe town emblem — an outlined oval loop enclosing a stylised character of diagonal strokes
